invests.text: PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 7.1S 76.0E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 7.6S 76.8E, APPROXIMATELY 261 NM EAST OF DIEGO GARCIA. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED (EIR) SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS A CONSOLIDATING LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION WITH STRONG MID-LEVEL TURNING. A 230030Z SSMIS 37GHZ MICROWAVE IMAGE PASS SHOWS IMPROVED CONVECTIVE BANDING WRAPPING INTO A BROAD LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC). UPPER-LEVEL ANALYSIS REVEALS A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (SST) OF 29-30 C, LOW TO MODERATE VERTICAL WIND SHEAR OF 15-20 KTS, AND ROBUST RADIAL OUTFLOW. GLOBAL MODELS ARE IN AGREEMENT THAT 98S IS FORECAST TO TRACK GENERALLY SOUTHEASTWARD TO SOUTHWARD WITH STEADY DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT 12-24 HOURS. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 23 TO 28 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1006 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS IS UPGRADED TO HIGH. SEE REF A (WTXS21 PGTW 230330) FOR FURTHER DETAILS.
